# Fixtures from other projects

Fixtures whose names start with `bm_` are the inputs of beautiful-mermaid's test
diagrams (https://github.com/lukilabs/beautiful-mermaid, MIT License, Copyright
(c) 2026 Craft Docs). Many of those came from mermaid-ascii
(https://github.com/AlexanderGrooff/mermaid-ascii, MIT License, Copyright (c)
Alexander Grooff). Only the Mermaid sources are reused. The expected drawings
are termaid's own.
